audit.why: Kennen at 950 range with Thundering Shuriken beating your 850 Avengerang at level 1, Akshan clawing back at 3-5 once Heroic Swing is up, and Kennen retaking the lane past two items matches the 50% over 16 games. Chart and sides left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer pointed every spike at Lightning Rush and called it 'the fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s - never fifteen - and it is a mobility tool, not the button that decides the lane. Slicing Maelstrom at 120s is the real spike, and Thundering Shuriken at 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4s is the poke clock.
audit.corrected: Repointed breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t and loading at Slicing Maelstrom with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stun mechanic itself was never spelled out on the full layer: Mark of the Storm stuns at three stacks, and Thundering Shuriken, Electrical Surge, Lightning Rush and Slicing Maelstrom each apply one.
audit.why: That is why you count marks rather than cooldowns - two marks already on you means any single button stuns. The content layer knew this; the full layer talked about a generic 'interrupt'.
audit.corrected: Added to report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization was the generic crit line against a champion who deals no physical damage at all.
audit.why: Every Kennen ability is magic damage, and Electrical Surge adds on-hit magic through his attacks, so magic resist - not armour - is what changes the trade.
